definition.overlap: four frozen cases in which two written wordings touch: containment, one shared character, abutting spans, and partial overlap without containment; each case declares answers, decision, stopped_at_pass and final exit before the reading
definition.swallowed: a written key is reported as swallowed when its first occurrence intersects a span that a previous pass masked; that is the direct evidence that masking deleted characters it needed
definition.three_entities: one sentence naming three entities: the disjoint case must answer 3 and stop at pass 4 by no_match (not by the pass bound); the straddling case must answer 2 and stop at pass 3
definition.stop_reporting: every case reports stopped_at_pass and final_exit, so a shortfall is never reported without the layer it stopped at
definition.regression: the 20 describe sentences must still reach 40/40 with the default two passes
definition.zeros: on the 18-key table, 12 unknown candidates and 18 byte fragments must answer 0
definition.rerun_anchors: R11-R15 each carry the commit at which their own runner bytes were last runnable; old reports are reproducible by checking out that commit, not orphans

criteria.overlap: every overlap case matches its frozen answers/decision/stopped_at_pass/final_exit exactly, wrong pointers 0, and the swallowed set equals the frozen one
criteria.three_entities: three_disjoint answers 3 with pass 4 exiting no_match; middle_wording_swallowed answers 2 and stops at pass 3 with the swallowed key named; three_records_same_start abstains at pass 1; same_address_three_times answers 1 entity
criteria.regression: 20 describe sentences still reach 40/40, wrong 0, all answered_pair
criteria.zeros: 12 unknown candidates answer 0 and 18 byte fragments answer 0
criteria.closed_state: the nine closed-state readings stay equal before and after
criteria.rerun: every row names a commit and a blob; a mismatch between report hash and blob hash is declared in the row rather than hidden
criteria.reporting: segments are reported separately; a clean overlap segment does not carry the three-entity segment
